name: Kosmos-1445
about: Kosmos-1445 (1983-017A), a crewed vehicle (BOR-4), launched 1983 Mar 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1983 Mar 16), held fixed
GCAT names the site (IOR) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
